policy: Only an authentic project/game image traceable to the project's pinned repository or an official project site is proposed. A code license is recorded as evidence but is not treated as automatic clearance for every image. Every candidate remains pending independent media/rights review before dashboard projection.
dashboard_rule: candidate_local_display_pending_independent_review means the image is narrow-use evidence for identifying the upstream project in the local dashboard. It does not authorize source export, promotional reuse, relicensing, or imply that third-party assets are covered by the code license.
